comments.text: I live in Squamish, BC- only an hr drive away from downtown Vancouver!

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Canada is breathtaking but the cost of living is a real challenge! Could you live in Canada on $2,500 a month? Yer or no?

comments.author: @LifeDocumentary-x7b
comments.text: If you could live in one type of place featured in travel documentaries for an entire year, would you choose a city, the mountains, the coast, or the countryside?

replies.author: @RealLifeExplorerUS
replies.text: I'd probably choose the mountains for a whole year. There's something so peaceful about waking up to fresh air, beautiful scenery, and the quiet of nature. The Canadian Rockies would be an amazing place to experience all four seasons!

comments.author: @georgemckinnon7134
comments.text: I don't have anything nice to say about Canada, it was already said in the documentary. I would not move back there for some of the reasons noted, such as high cost of living and lack of jobs.

replies.author: @RealLifeExplorerUS
replies.text: Thank you for sharing your honest thoughts.❤️ I can understand why you wouldn't want to move back, especially with the rising cost of living and challenges of finding good jobs. Canada has so much natural beauty, but everyday life can be difficult when financial stability is out of reach.
